name: decant-site
description: Repo-wide dev tooling. The apps live in client/ and server/, each with its own package.json.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm --prefix client run build
